title: PlantAdminSettings
description: Stamped-internal plant levers (L5 Internal Console). Not customer-facing. Includes practicality gate profile for AD-5 / AD-7.

stamped_rx_gate_enabled.description: When true, prescriptions enter pending_stamped_review until staff approve.

practicality_gate_mode.description: Preset bundle for AD-5 practicality gate magnitude. Individual flags override.

require_named_owner.description: Reject orphan owners (e.g. bare 'maintenance' without role+department).

min_impact_confidence.description: Floor for impact confidence. Presets: strict≈0.6, balanced≈0.5, lenient≈0.4 when unset.

allow_illustrative_impact.description: Permit [illustrative] ₹ on client card until M&V baseline lock.

auto_withhold_on_gate_fail.description: When true, failed gate → withheld; when false → pending_stamped_review.
